description: Live asking-market state for a UK area, collected weekly from property portals: active listing count, new listings, how many have been price-reduced, median asking price, and median time on market, plus active rent listings and median asking rent a month. Answers "is this area moving or stuck?" and "are sellers cutting prices here?" — the negotiation-side data that completed-sales records (which lag by months) cannot show. The result states the week it covers and warns if that week is not current. Takes a postcode, a postcode district or a place name. England & Wales, sale listings and rent listings. It reports the market as it is now and does not forecast prices.

area.description: A postcode ("E17 7AB"), postcode district ("E17") or place name ("Walthamstow", "Hackney")

name: get_market_pulse
title: Live asking-market pulse
